info.title: StructPaper API
info.description: OpenAPI 3.1 contract specification for StructPaper backend and automated client SDK.

AccountProfile.description: The logged-in user, with the roles they hold and the capabilities those roles grant (what the UI may show).

capabilities.description: Effective capabilities of the user. The UI asks for these, never for role names.

UserRoleAssignmentView.description: A role held by a user, optionally scoped to one journal (null = global).

InviteUserResponse.description: Result of issuing an invitation link. The raw token/link is only ever returned here (never stored).

lockReason.description: Why the current viewer can not edit this user (null = editable). SELF: nobody changes their own roles/status. REQUIRES_SUPERADMIN: only a SuperAdmin may modify a SuperAdmin.

articleType.description: Code of one of the journal's article types

ManuscriptAccess.description: What the current user may do with this manuscript (computed by the API rules).

ProfilePin.description: The profile versions a paper was written under

articleType.description: Code of one of the journal's article types; null for none

version.description: The paper's version after the change (its ETag)
